title: Distinguish a stage default from an item override
when: Reading an item level or choosing its staffing adjustment
need: Read stage levels on workflow stage cards. Item details labels Default and Override only when the effective item level differs, with its adjustment and reason. Equal bounds or clamped shifts show no Level row. Execution posture carries no level card. Stored overrides, explicit launch-level persistence and stage handoffs retain their existing semantics.
surface: Item details → Level; Workflows → stage cards; session level routing guide.
review: Source and focused renderer tests; served browser behavior awaits deployment proof.
